items.title: OpenAI, Anthropic are 'gambling with our lives': Fmr. employee warns of AI's threat to humanity
items.summary: A former Anthropic employee stated on X on Tuesday that both Anthropic and OpenAI are "not acting responsibly" and are "gambling with our lives." He also noted that many people building AI technology believe it could kill humanity in the next decade. Sherwood News head of markets Luke Kawa and Investopedia editor in chief Caleb Silver discuss the details with Morning Brief host Julie Hyman.

items.title: Cloudflare Surges 9% on OpenAI Security Partnership, Zscaler Rises 3%
